body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Samsung Mobile and Sprint announced that the Samsung Moment has been selected as the first phone to showcase a demonstration of a Mobile Digital TV chip at CES Unveiled at CES 2010 in Las Vegas.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
